text_block_list.text:
With strides sharp enough to crack open
sea
urchins, Голд Шипп claims victory and
receives the
first clue from Эйсин Флэш.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Not long after, Голд Шипп and Tosen
Jordan find
themselves embroiled in a
fight over the last
remaining dessert at
lunch.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Their fates are so intertwined that the
two once
argued over how spicy chicken
wing sauce should
be (at least,
according to Голд Шип's memory).
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite the general falsity of Gold
Ship's claims,
they're enough to incite
yet another argument.
Now, the two of
them will settle things once and
for all
on the track!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
